Protection without interruption

A blocked card shouldn’t block your day.

Real purchases get declined. Fraud can slip through. And a compromised debit card can leave customers waiting about five business days for a replacement.

Try the protection demo
Customers

Time, uncertainty, lost access

A checkout decline means an interrupted purchase and a call to the fraud line. A replacement-card wait disrupts everyday spending.

Fraud & operations teams

Losses and avoidable calls

Missed fraud creates losses. Incorrect decisions create service demand: the source deck reports 350K–400K fraud-related calls each month.

The proposal

Check. Confirm. Protect. Restore.

A bank-owned decision engine combines bank behavior and network signals, verifies unusual purchases in-app, and supports immediate digital-card recovery.

Three decisions. One connected experience.

Approve routine purchases with less friction.
Verify unusual activity with a clear “Was this you?” prompt.
Block and restore when fraud is identified, with a digital credential for supported mobile wallets.

Option C is the team’s recommendation because it connects fraud decisions to customer recovery. The demonstration uses transparent rules to illustrate that workflow; it is not the proposed production AI model.
